verdict.rationale: User access reviews are a fair question for a compliance platform like Oneleet, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows integrations that monitor user accounts and access (GitHub user access, AWS IAM users, Google Workspace accounts) and Fieldwork's scheduled evidence collection. These are adjacent monitoring and evidence features. Nothing documents periodic access review campaigns, reviewer sign-off in the app, or review artifacts filed to an evidence library.

support.subject: As a security engineer, periodic user access reviews run across connected apps in the platform — reviewers sign off in-app and the artifact lands in the evidence library
